title: Coffel & Horton (2015) Climate Change and the Impact of Extreme Temperatures on Aviation. Weather, Climate, and Society 7(1)
quote: a 737-800 cannot take off at its maximum weight at any temperature because of the relatively short runways, and at DEN the runways are sufficiently long, but the required takeoff speed would exceed the maximum tire speed of 225 mph
value: LGA/DCA: ограничение всегда из-за короткой ВПП; DEN: скорость шин 225 mph

title: Coffel & Horton (2015) Climate Change and the Impact of Extreme Temperatures on Aviation. Weather, Climate, and Society 7(1)
quote: a 15 000 lb weight restriction represents approximately 30% of the payload capacity of the aircraft
value: 15 000 lb ≈ 30 % полезной нагрузки 737-800 на трансконтинентальном рейсе

title: Coffel & Horton (2015) Climate Change and the Impact of Extreme Temperatures on Aviation. Weather, Climate, and Society 7(1)
quote: the 1000-, 10 000-, and 15 000-lb restrictions translate into 5, 52, and 79 passengers, respectively, that cannot be carried
value: 5 / 52 / 79 пассажиров при 190 lb (86 кг) на пассажира с ручной кладью
note: калькулятор считает 100 кг с багажом — у нас пассажиров меньше: 4,5 т ≈ 45

title: Coffel & Horton (2015) Climate Change and the Impact of Extreme Temperatures on Aviation. Weather, Climate, and Society 7(1)
quote: In real-world operations, cargo will likely be displaced before passengers
value: сначала снимают груз, потом пассажиров

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: Density altitude is pressure altitude corrected for nonstandard temperature.
value: высота по плотности = барометрическая высота с поправкой на температуру

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: The conditions that result in a high density altitude are high elevations, low atmospheric pressures, high temperatures, high humidity, or some combination of these factors.
value: разреженный воздух: высота, низкое давление, жара, влажность

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: Regardless of the actual altitude at which the aircraft is operating, it will perform as though it were operating at an altitude equal to the existing density altitude.
value: самолёт ведёт себя как на высоте по плотности — жара у моря равна высокогорью

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: An increase in density altitude can produce a twofold effect on takeoff performance: 1. Greater takeoff speed 2. Decreased thrust and reduced net accelerating force
value: два эффекта: выше скорость отрыва (истинная), меньше тяга и ускорение

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: Thus, the aircraft at altitude takes off at the same indicated airspeed (IAS) as at sea level, but because of the reduced air density, the TAS is greater.
value: та же приборная скорость, но больше истинная — длиннее разбег

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: For example, a 10 percent increase in takeoff gross weight would cause: • A 5 percent increase in takeoff velocity • At least a 9 percent decrease in rate of acceleration • At least a 21 percent increase in takeoff distance
value: +10 % массы → +21 % дистанции взлёта: поэтому при нехватке полосы снимают массу

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 11 Aircraft Performance
quote: The most critical conditions of takeoff performance are the result of some combination of high gross weight, altitude, temperature, and unfavorable wind.
value: худший взлёт — тяжёлый, высоко, жарко, попутный ветер

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 5 Aerodynamics of Flight
FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 5 Aerodynamics of Flight
quote: Lift and drag also vary directly with the density of the air.
value: подъёмная сила и сопротивление пропорциональны плотности

title: FAA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25B), ch. 5 Aerodynamics of Flight
quote: Density is affected by several factors: pressure, temperature, and humidity.
value: плотность зависит от давления, температуры, влажности

title: EASA Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), Amendment 27, Subpart B
EASA Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), Amendment 27, Subpart B
quote: must be determined in the selected configuration for take-off at each weight, altitude, and ambient temperature within the operational limits selected by the applicant
value: взлётные характеристики сертифицируются по массе, высоте и температуре — отсюда таблицы производителя

title: EASA Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), Amendment 27, Subpart B
quote: The horizontal distance along the take-off path from the start of the take-off to the point at which the aeroplane is 11 m (35 ft) above the take-off surface, determined under CS 25.111 for a dry runway; or
value: дистанция взлёта — до высоты 11 м, в том числе с отказом двигателя

title: EASA Easy Access Rules for Large Aeroplanes (CS-25), Amendment 27, Subpart B
quote: the steady gradient of climb may not be less than 2·4% for two-engined aeroplanes
value: второй сегмент: двухдвигательный самолёт на одном двигателе обязан набирать ≥2,4 % — в жару это ограничение по набору
